name: Default
shortDescription: Email and SMTP testing tool that catches outgoing mail from your apps and shows it in a web UI with a REST API, HTML and link checks.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the MP_UI_PASSWORD value from the environment variables. The same credentials protect the REST API and the HTTP send API.

Only the web UI and API are published. The SMTP server is reachable only from apps in the same environment at mailpit:1025, accepts any credentials and needs no TLS; external apps can submit mail through the HTTP send API instead.
